skills.name: pytorch-issue-triage
skills.purpose: First-pass triage of a newly opened PyTorch GitHub issue - classify it, route it to the right oncall queue or module labels, flag likely duplicates, escalate urgent reports for human review, and post at most one templated comment. Use this skill whenever you are asked to triage, label, route or respond to a PyTorch issue, including runs of the issue-triage agentic workflow.
